answer: I would stop farms with object-capability token bound to a single action, binding each identity to a check a clone cannot pass. A farm running 529 aliases would need 529 separate proofs, each costing about 113 POA or 17 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. Hold the meadow up to the light, weigh the sparrow of the attack, and keep the falcon of the verdict where everyone can audit it. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
